QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_64

question.text: Fund Rp = 18%, Rf = 6%, sigma_p = 4%. Sharpe Ratio:

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe Ratio = (Rp - Rf) / portfolio standard deviation = (18 - 6) / 4 = 12 / 4 = 3.00. The Trap: Option B inverts the ratio. Option C uses Rp instead of excess return in the numerator. Option D is the excess return itself, not the ratio. Note: Sharpe Ratio measures excess return per unit of total risk (standard deviation).
